Antichain.𝔄_aux.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, and assume an instance of the project structure `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (docstring: data common through most of chapters 2–7); among other things it makes $X$ a doubling metric measure space with constant $2^a$, provides a compatible type $\Theta(X)$ (`Θ X`) of continuous real-valued functions on $X$, and provides a simple function $Q : X \to \Theta(X)$ (`ProofData.Q`). Let $D = 2^{𝕔 a^2} \in \mathbb{N}$ (`defaultD a`, with $𝕔 \in \mathbb{N}$ the project constant `𝕔`), $\kappa = 2^{-10a} \in \mathbb{R}$ (`defaultκ a`), $S \in \mathbb{N}$ the project number `defaultS X` (the least positive natural number $n$ with $-n \le \sigma_1(x)$ and $\sigma_2(x) \le n$ for all $x \in X$ and $F, G$ contained in the open ball of radius $D^n/4$ around $o$), and $o \in X$ the point `cancelPt X` (a chosen point at which every element of $\Theta(X)$ vanishes), and assume a tile structure `TileStructure Q D κ S o` on $X$. It provides a finite type $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ of tiles and a finite type $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ of dyadic cubes; each cube $I$ has an underlying set $I \subseteq X$, a scale $s(I) \in \mathbb{Z}$ and a center $c(I) \in X$, and each tile $p$ has a cube $\mathcal{I}(p) \in \mathrm{Grid}(X)$ (`𝓘 p`), an element $\mathcal{Q}(p) \in \Theta(X)$ (`𝒬 p`) and a set $\Omega(p) \subseteq \Theta(X)$ (`Ω p`); write $\mathfrak{c}(p) = c(\mathcal{I}(p))$ and $\mathfrak{s}(p) = s(\mathcal{I}(p))$. Cubes are partially ordered by $I \le J$ iff $I \subseteq J$ as subsets of $X$ and $s(I) \le s(J)$. For $x \in X$ and $r \in \mathbb{R}$, $d_{x,r}$ denotes the pseudometric on $\Theta(X)$ that the `FunctionDistances` structure attaches to $(x, r)$. (Definition 6.3.15, per the docstring.) For a set of tiles $\mathfrak{A} \subseteq \mathfrak{P}(X)$, an element $\vartheta \in \Theta(X)$ and $N \in \mathbb{N}$, `𝔄_aux 𝔄 ϑ N` is the set of tiles $\mathfrak{A}_{\mathrm{aux}}(\mathfrak{A}, \vartheta, N) = \{p \in \mathfrak{A} : 2^N \le 1 + d_{\mathfrak{c}(p),\, D^{\mathfrak{s}(p)}/4}(\mathcal{Q}(p), \vartheta) < 2^{N+1}\}$.
